provenance.what: the tpuv6e target as its MXU is: registers of 128 lanes x 8 words of 32 bits, an array of 256 x 256 (vcix-accelerator libtpuv6.so). The scratchpad is the same 128 MiB over half the lanes. The unit's queues hold 512 rows each, a model choice (no published depth): a bf16 stream's pops lag its pushes by 64 inputs, two short of its delay line's (4 x 128 - 1 cycles), and an f32 stream's by the delay's 66; no push waits on a pop behind it.
provenance.address_map: the tpuv6e address map, from before targets were written by hand
